title: Dress Code Guidelines
content: Traditional Indian attire is recommended for visiting Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha. The dress code is designed to maintain the sanctity and spiritual atmosphere of the temple.

guidelines.description: Traditional Indian saree is the most preferred attire for women
Plain or simple designed kurta-pajama is recommended for men
Traditional dhoti is also acceptable for men
Shorts, mini-skirts, sleeveless tops, and revealing clothing should be avoided

tips: During festivals and special occasions, elaborate traditional attire is appreciated. The temple shop also offers traditional clothing if needed.
